name: Futaimo Days ~Onii-chan, Naisho de Shiyo♪~
original_name: ふたいもデイズ ～おにいちゃん、ナイショでシよ♪～
source:
"Brother-in-law." "Brother-in-law♪"

No matter how you look at it, these two are the mirror image of each other. They are my little sisters, or rather, my little sisters-in-law. 

My father, who had lost his wife early and struggled to raise me, remarried a beautiful widow in a similar situation. The widow... My mother-in-law had two cute daughters. We are going to be brother-in-law and sister-in-law a little apart in age.

When we decided to live together, “I wanted a big brother♪” I was happy to receive such a welcome, but maybe they were being a little too clingy. We were practically lovers now.

"He's mine!!" "He's mine!!"

Even real siblings—no, real siblings—wouldn’t be this attached to each other, but I can’t say to stop it. They are a little worrysome, but my little sisters are cute. They may be my sisters-in-law, but I don't feel bad to have cute girls like and look up to me.

One night, those days continued. As I was taking a bath, the door suddenly opened...and my sisters-in-law came in! Just having my sister-in-law come in while I'm bathing would be incredibly troubling, so why are the two of them completely naked...!? And no matter how you look at it, it looks like a contraceptive, a condom. I was at point-blank range, lost in thought as to what to do.

Before I knew it, my sisters-in-law came closer...

translation:
“小舅子。”“姐夫♪”

无论怎么看，这两个女孩都像彼此的镜像。她们是我的妹妹，更准确地说，是我的小姨子。

父亲很早便失去妻子，辛苦把我养大，后来又娶了一位处境相似的美丽寡妇。那位继母有两个可爱的女儿。我们年龄相仿，即将成为姐夫与小姨子。

决定同居后，她们说道：“我想要一个哥哥♪”我很高兴得到这样的欢迎，可她们似乎有些过于黏人。现在，我们几乎已经像恋人一样了。

“他是我的！！”“他是我的！！”

即使是真正的兄弟姐妹——不，正因为是真正的姐妹——也不该如此亲密，可我实在说不出拒绝的话。她们虽然让人有些担心，却也是可爱的妹妹。即便成为我的小姨子，我也不讨厌被可爱的女孩喜欢、仰慕。

这样的日子持续着。某天夜里，我正在洗澡，门突然打开……两位小姨子走了进来！洗澡时被小姨子撞见已经够麻烦了，可她们为什么全都一丝不挂……！？而且，她们手里拿着的怎么看都是避孕套。我近距离看着这一切，完全不知道该怎么办。

不知不觉间，小姨子们朝我靠近……
